verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak stack: the subcopy is indented to x≈123, so it doesn't line up with the left-aligned headline. The LIMITED badge and the Enter Now button are jammed side by side with mismatched baselines and left edges, so they read as one cramped row, not a clear CTA. A pushes everything into the top two-thirds and leaves roughly the bottom 250px as dead space, which makes it badly lopsided. B shifts the same stack down so the weight sits near the middle and is much better balanced, but it still has the alignment and CTA-grouping flaws.
